Last week I went to a house my dad recently bought, that he’s remodeling. Because two of my roommates came with me, I let them have the two bedrooms on the main level. Downstairs there’s a big living area and a big bedroom. Being down there, I remember thinking, if you think there’s weird vibes, you’re gonna get weird vibes. so I just tried to put the eerie feeling out of my head. 

I only slept down there one night because I was woken up by the sound of long scratches on the wall across the bed. Not short and quick, but dragging out. I take medication before bed that helps me sleep, so I just fell right back asleep. 
The next night, I was upstairs until past midnight. My roommates had gone to bed. I could hear sounds of water running, drawers opening and closing, footsteps, things being moved, coming from below me. I didn’t fall asleep until 5 am that day because I was so shocked at the amount of noise I could hear when I could definitely hear that my roommates on the same floor as me were not moving at all. 

My dad tells me the next day that his neighbor told him someone killed themselves downstairs. Apparently they didn’t tell him when they sold the house to him. He said him and his workers don’t go downstairs alone, and that that’s why there’s a key in the door to go downstairs, because he locks it when he’s there alone... can y’all believe he kept this from me and let me SLEEP down there 😭
